environment.scope: Repository-only / DARK. Corrective fix for two defects the first bounded account-46 one-shot attestation (pkt-127) surfaced. DEFECT 1: the operator wrapper's _last_json parsed stdout line-by-line, so it could not parse the backend copier_verifier_window command's PRETTY-printed multi-line JSON (json.dumps indent=1) and wrongly reported 'could not read status' at the read-only preflight (before any key entry). DEFECT 2: run_oneshot_attest.py::_post_once retained only the response's top-level status ('rejected') and discarded the backend's sanitised rejection reason, so the precise 401 cause was unrecoverable. This PR hardens _last_json (parse compact AND pretty; tolerate only LEADING banner noise; fail closed on empty/garbage/partial/ambiguous-multiple/trailing-garbage/non-object) and adds _classify_post_response which retains ONLY the backend's own allow-listed sanitised reason code (else rejected_unknown / http_<code>), never raw body/secret/signature/login. NO deploy, NO host contact, NO real secret handled, NO verifier window, NO flag enablement, NO task trigger, NO account-48 contact, NO broker order, NO migration.

expected_results: _last_json parses the backend's real pretty-printed multi-line status JSON so the preflight PROCEEDS, parses compact Windows JSON, tolerates a LEADING banner, and FAILS CLOSED (None) on empty/garbage/partial/truncated/two-or-more-concatenated/trailing-garbage/non-object input. _classify_post_response retains ONLY the backend's sanitised reason code when it is allow-listed (mirrors attestation_api._AUTH_FAIL + _MALFORMED + malformed_json/body_too_large/account_not_found), collapses a missing/unknown/non-string/injected reason on a 'rejected' response to 'rejected_unknown', surfaces replayed/disabled/unavailable as themselves, keeps the http_<code> fallback for any unrecognised body shape, and NEVER emits the raw body, envelope, signature, broker login, headers or exception text. A 200 'verified' response stays backward compatible (verified True, reason 'verified'). The sanitised reason reaches the written result file.
